title: Navigate entity documentation to the referencing slide and Item
preconditions: Use technical-inventory-ui fixture with FeatureFlag System and checkout-flag/shared Item; preserve the exact original slide URL.

steps.action: Open FeatureFlag from the directory and read explanation and usages.
steps.expected_result: Canonical r1 opens, interaction explanation is visible, and usage names shared.

steps.action: Follow shared usage, open the Item's definition, then close the drawer.
steps.expected_result: The checkout-flag slide opens; the Item opens System r1; closing restores the Item control and original slide URL.

steps.action: Revise System to r2, visit r1 and inspect its usages, then choose current definition.
steps.expected_result: r1 and its usages visibly report stale; current definition opens r2 without silently substituting it for r1.
